WHAT WE DO

One contractor, every trade a display project touches

From the steel that holds a screen to the software that drives it — we scope, build and maintain the whole thing under one contract.

DISPLAY

LED & Visual Display

Custom indoor and outdoor LED pixel displays, LCD & LED video walls, poster and rental screens, built to any size and pixel pitch.

CONTROL

Audiovisual & Control Systems

Extron, Crestron, AMX and other CMS platforms, PA systems, projectors and screens, and home theatre installations.

STEEL

Steel & Fabrication

  • Steel & stainless steel structures
  • Welding & custom fabrication
  • Aluminium works
INTERIOR

Interiors & Cladding

  • Glass & gypsum works
  • ACP cladding
  • Interior design & fit-outs
CIVIL

Civil & MEP

  • Civil construction works
  • Mechanical, electrical & plumbing
  • Duct & HVAC works
EVENTS

Exhibitions, Signage & Events

Full event support, branding and advertising, digital and 3D letter signage, conference halls and auditoriums, from concept to teardown.

CARE

Security & Facility Maintenance

CCTV camera solutions and ongoing maintenance & facility services, backed by a 24-hour support desk with 1-hour response.

LED PRODUCT RANGE

A display format for every space

All modules, cabinets and pixel pitches are custom-sized on request — dimensions in our catalogue are a starting reference.

Indoor LED Display

Modules, die-cast aluminium and iron-box cabinets from P1.25 to P4 pitch, with front or rear maintenance.

Outdoor LED Cabinets

IP65-rated waterproof, die-cast, hydraulic and energy-saving cabinets built for Riyadh heat and dust.

LED Rental Screen

Lightweight die-cast panels with quick-lock frames, built for fast rigging and de-rigging on event sites.

Flexible & Crystal Screens

Curved flexible modules, transparent LED crystal film and grille screens for glass facades and feature walls.

LED Poster Display

Freestanding indoor, outdoor and foldable poster screens for retail entrances and lobbies.

Front Desk & Meeting Displays

Curved reception counters and large-format meeting room walls with seamless splicing.

Standing, Matrix & Floor Tile

Standing posters, mechanical matrix walls and load-rated LED floor tiles for stage and retail builds.

Custom-Shaped Screens

Spheres, cubes, cans and rotating installations engineered for brand activations and exhibitions.
